Marina is a modern music streaming application that provides you with access to a vast library of music, playlists, and personalized recommendations. Enjoy your favorite tracks anytime, anywhere.

• Stream unlimited music
• Create and manage playlists
• Discover new artists and songs
• Offline listening support
• High-quality audio streaming
• Personalized recommendations
• Dark mode for comfortable viewing
• Secure biometric authentication

Welcome to Marina!

Getting Started:
1. Browse the music library to discover new songs
2. Create playlists by adding your favorite tracks
3. Use the search function to find specific artists or songs
4. Enable offline mode to download music for offline listening

Features:
• Streaming: Stream music directly from our library
• Playlists: Create and manage your personal playlists
• Search: Find songs, artists, and albums quickly
• Offline Mode: Download music to listen without internet
• Settings: Customize your experience in the Settings menu

Troubleshooting:
• If music doesn't play, check your internet connection
• Clear app cache if you experience performance issues
• Make sure you have sufficient storage for offline downloads
• Restart the app if you encounter any errors

For more assistance, please contact our support team through the app settings.
Your ultimate music streaming experience. Discover, listen, and enjoy millions of songs at your fingertips.
